title: Microsoft Agent 365: the control plane for agents
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing qualifications and portal paths are supported. Hold for the Conditional Access API example: it supplies an agent-selection condition but omits the request body needed to create the stated block policy safely in report-only mode.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Retrieving connected-platform telemetry can incur provider-billed data access or query charges.
claims.quote: Retrieving agent telemetry from the connected platform might query the provider's own logging or data services (for example, Google BigQuery or Amazon S3) and can incur data access or query charges that the provider bills.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Synchronization is manual and does not currently run on a schedule.
claims.quote: Manual synchronization only. Agent 365 doesn't currently sync on a schedule, and Microsoft doesn't prescribe a fixed synchronization interval.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Source deletions are not guaranteed to remove registry entries automatically, and Microsoft advises manual cleanup when needed.
claims.quote: Synchronization doesn't currently guarantee that an agent removed from the source platform is automatically removed from the Microsoft 365 agent registry.

claims.claim: Not every agent has a Microsoft Entra agent identity.
claims.quote: Your Microsoft Entra tenant might contain AI agents with or without a Microsoft Entra agent identity.

claims.claim: Product experiences can fall back to standard service principals without agent-specific tracking and controls when agent identities are unavailable.
claims.quote: Microsoft product experiences that assume agent identity availability (for example, Copilot Studio agents, Security Copilot scenario agents, Microsoft Entra Conditional Access Optimization Agent) might fail or fall back to standard service principals that lack agent-specific tracking and controls.

claims.claim: Conditional Access can prevent existing and new agent identities from authenticating and receiving tokens.
claims.quote: Conditional Access policies can block authentication and token issuance of agent identities. Applying the policies prevents existing and new agent identities from authenticating, but it doesn't prevent the creation of agent identities in your tenant.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft cautions that disabling agent identities can cause existing agents to fail.
claims.quote: Existing agents running in your organization might begin to fail.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk

claims.claim: The printed POST call with only conditions.clientApplications.includeAgentIdServicePrincipals set to All supplies the API equivalent of the stated agent block policy.
claims.quote: A valid policy should contain at least one application rule - for example, 'includeApplications': 'none', one user rule - for example, 'includeUsers': 'none', and at least one grant/session control.
claims.fix: Replace the shorthand call in controls[4].api and its rendered table cell with POST /beta/identity/conditionalAccess/policies and the JSON body from Policy 1 at https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/agent-id/disable-agent-identities#create-conditional-access-policies-to-disable-agent-activities: {"displayName":"Block all agent identities from accessing resources","conditions":{"clientApplications":{"includeAgentIdServicePrincipals":["All"],"excludeAgentIdServicePrincipals":[],"agentIdServicePrincipalFilter":null},"applications":{"includeApplications":["All"],"excludeApplications":[]}},"grantControls":{"operator":"AND","builtInControls":["block"]},"state":"enabledForReportingButNotEnforced"}. Keep the existing docs link. The current text omits the required resource selection and grant control, provides no request body, and does not encode the promised report-only state.
